guide.[t]title: Hey There, New Fighters! Street Fighter 6 Tips | STREET FIGHTER 6 | CAPCOM
guide.[t]description: Welcome to the world of Street Fighter 6!Here are some tips from us to find YOUR way to play.
guide.[t]top_title:
Welcome to the world of Street Fighter 6!
Here are some tips from us to find YOUR way to play.
guide.[t]top_for_text1: We got just what you need if you're here thinking about giving SF6 a try!
guide.[t]top_for_text2: Or maybe you're a fighting game noob looking to get more out of the game! We got you!
guide.[t]top_nav_wt: For Those That Want to Explore the World of Street Fighter
guide.[t]top_nav_bh: For Those That Want to Live it Up With Other Players
guide.[t]top_nav_fg: For Those That Want to Fight With Legendary Fighters Themselves
guide.[t]wt_intro_text: If you've been playing through the story mode, you've been getting used to fighting game controls without even noticing it! Who knows, maybe you'll find yourself taking down other World Tourists in the Battle Hub soon!
guide.[t]wt_step1_title:
Modern Controls
are your partner
on this adventure!
guide.[t]wt_step1_text:
Beat down baddies using Modern Controls, a control scheme that lets anyone use special attacks no sweat in this sandbox-style story mode.
Enjoy the story of Street Fighter 6 with your very own avatar and learn the basics of fighting games as you do.
guide.[t]wt_step1_pic_text: Use special attacks with just a single input!
guide.[t]wt_step2_title:
Travel the world
and meet the
most legendary
of fighters!
guide.[t]wt_step2_text:
Learn the moves of the most famous fighters on the planet.
Give them presents and max our your friendship! (And snag their Outfit 2 in the process!)
guide.[t]wt_step2_pic_text2: Get some thorough training from the best of the best!
guide.[t]wt_step3_title:
Take on other players once
you've got your groove!
guide.[t]wt_step3_text:
Take a trip to the Battle Hub once your avatar has gained a few levels! That circle in the middle of the room is an arena made just for players to battle their avatars!
Level Up and Snag Gear in WT → Battle in BH → Level Up in WT...
Yo, I'm Level 100 Already lol
guide.[t]wt_step3_pic_text1: Participate in Avatar Battle in the Battle Hub!
guide.[t]wt_step3_pic_text3: Power Up and Deck Out Your Avatar!
guide.[t]wt_step4_title:
Mastered a master's
style? Give them
a shot in a player
match!
guide.[t]wt_step4_text: Use your favorite master's style in World Tour for a while and you'll be ready to take on other players in no time! Check out Battle Hub servers with the beginners mark. Choose your character in Battle Settings and pop a squat at a cabinet!
guide.[t]wt_chracter_text: Every time a new character is added to the game, they'll have their own missions added to World Tour. Practicing in Battle Hub is great and all, but don't forget to check back into World Tour every now and again!
guide.[t]wt_button_text: Hey, my favorite streamer is online! Time to grind out some levels in World Tour while I watch.
guide.[t]wt_button_title:
Travel around the world of
Street Fighter 6!
guide.[t]bh_intro_text: Battle Hub #0006 is my favorite spot! I live and breathe the party!
guide.[t]bh_step1_title:
Create an avatar
that fits your
style and hit up
Battle Hub!
guide.[t]bh_step1_text: First, you gotta make an avatar to rep you! There are over a trillion different combination of all the parts in the character creator! Once you're satisfied with your avatar, dive right in to one of the servers with the beginner mark and give things a try!
guide.[t]bh_step2_title:
Feel the love in
your very own
club!
guide.[t]bh_step2_text: Your avatar may be brand new, but it doesn't have to be alone! Join a Club or make your own and connect with the people!
guide.[t]bh_step3_text: It's time to find a battle cabinet and get fighting! This mark shows anyone who's around your skill level. If you feel like taking a break, grab some ice cream, kick back, and watch other people go at it for a bit!
guide.[t]bh_step4_text: Strike a pose in the center ring and let off some steam! Use the avatar you trained up in World Tour and battle. A smart player will take what they learned here and go level up in World Tour and maybe learn some new moves!
guide.[t]bh_step5_title:
Tons of events
to get down with!
guide.[t]bh_step5_text: Chat up the staff of the Battle Hub and participate in events of all kinds! We got tournaments, surveys, and much, much more!
guide.[t]bh_step6_text: Take on challenges and save up Kudos. That'll level up your Fighting Pass real quick, netting you a bunch of rewards!
guide.[t]bh_step7_text: I always make sure the Hub Goods Shop is stocked with the hottest fashion to customize your avatar with. It's up to you to start the trends!
guide.[t]bh_encore_title: We've still got plenty to enjoy too!
guide.[t]bh_encore_text: Extreme Battles that break all the rules of fighting games, retro games, all kinds of stuff! You can even have a rave with your Club at the DJ booth! Snap a pic with photo mode and upload it on your socials!
guide.[t]bh_button_text: Meet up with friends both real and virtual in the Battle Hub and get down!
guide.[t]fg_intro_text: Earn your place in ranked. This is for the warriors that want to inhale dinner as quick as possible so they can dive into ranked and the training room already.
guide.[t]fg_step1_text: First time playing, you say? Then Modern Controls will be your best friend. Trust me.
guide.[t]fg_step2_text: Drive Impacts, Drive Parry, Drive Rush, oh my! Check out the All section of the Modern Controls tutorial if you're having trouble wrapping your head around the Drive system!
guide.[t]fg_step3_text: If you feel any kind of connection with a character, that's the one for you. Make sure you check out the Modern Controls version of their Character Guide to learn the basics.
guide.[t]fg_step4_text: Think you're good to go just because you finished the basic Combo Trials? Wrong! Practice makes perfect! You must be able to do a combo ten times in a row before you have it memorized down to your bones!
guide.[t]fg_step5_text: It's now time to hit Training and apply the combos you learned in Combo Trials! Try setting up level 4 CPU from the Standard CPU Battle section of the Simple Training Settings. If you manage to get 10 wins before they do, kick up the level by one until you beat the level 6 CPU the same way. That means it's rank match time.
guide.[t]fg_step6_text: Your first ten matches when starting ranked are your placement matches. Finish those and you'll be fighting against players close to your skill level. Want to know a secret? Ranked matches are actually easier for beginners than casuals matches. So don't be scared! Dive in and give it a try!
guide.[t]fg_step7_title:
A journey begins with a single step.
Custom Rooms will get you ready.
guide.[t]fg_step7_text: Think of Custom Rooms like an online training room and get some pointers! You can even use voice chat if you want. Don't forget to pass along what you've learned to newbies!
guide.[t]fg_step8_title:
Not fighting?
You can still be training!
guide.[t]fg_step8_text: Too tired for Ranked Matches, you say? Don't be like that! A true fighter brushes up on their knowledge by watching things like Street Fighter League and Capcom Pro Tour.
guide.[t]fg_rest_title: Hop by the Battle Hub when you need a recharge.
guide.[t]fg_rest_text: The Battle Hub is perfect for a change of pace! Don't go bullying any newbies you find too hard now!
guide.[t]fg_button_text:
Time for some Ranked Matches!
See you in the Master ranks!
